title: Delhi HC Directs MCD to Form Panel on Unsafe Buildings During GRAP Curbs
case_name: Suo motu cognizance of dilapidated and structurally unsafe buildings during GRAP restrictions
reported_by: Press Trust of India (via The Week)
card_summary: Justice Saurabh Banerjee directed the MCD Commissioner, in consultation with the Delhi Chief Minister, to set up a committee on buildings found dilapidated or structurally unsafe under Section 348 of the Delhi Municipal Corporation Act, 1957. As demolition is barred during GRAP restrictions, the committee is to examine sealing, repair or controlled demolition instead, and is to be formed within a week.
card_tip: Where GRAP restrictions bar demolition of a building flagged as unsafe, owners and residents should expect civic authorities to pursue interim steps such as sealing or repair orders rather than wait for the ban to lift.
